items.input: Write a JavaScript CommonJS module that exports a function `fizzbuzz(n)` returning "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for multiples of 5, "FizzBuzz" for multiples of both, else the number as a string. Use module.exports = { fizzbuzz }. Reply with only a fenced code block.
Write a JavaScript CommonJS module exporting `dedupe(arr)` that removes duplicates while PRESERVING first-occurrence order. Use module.exports = { dedupe }. Reply with only a fenced code block.

Write a JavaScript CommonJS module exporting `isBalanced(s)` returning true when (), [] and {} are correctly nested and closed. Use module.exports = { isBalanced }. Reply with only a fenced code block.
Write a JavaScript CommonJS module exporting `toRoman(n)` converting an integer 1-3999 to a Roman numeral. Use module.exports = { toRoman }. Reply with only a fenced code block.

Write a JavaScript CommonJS module exporting `mean(nums)` returning the arithmetic mean, and returning null for an empty array (do not divide by zero). Use module.exports = { mean }. Reply with only a fenced code block.
Write a JavaScript CommonJS module exporting `flatten(arr)` that deeply flattens nested arrays to a single level. Use module.exports = { flatten }. Reply with only a fenced code block.
